name: queryFilter
description: This function creates a new Query that returns all rows from an query that match the given filter.
syntax: queryFilter( query query, function filter, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: filter
params.description:
A function/closure that implements the following constructor

`function(struct row[, number rowNumber, query query]) { return true/false; }`

for best performance, use scoped variables, like `arguments.row`, instead of just `row`

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
